plan_summary: The assessment will proceed in five stages: gathering system context, executing comprehensive vulnerability scans, aggregating and triaging the raw data, prioritizing risks, and finally generating a structured, actionable remediation plan.
assumptions: The user has necessary administrative access (sudo/root) to the Linux host.
The host is network accessible for external scanning tools.
Standard vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., OpenVAS, Nmap, specific package checkers) are available or can be installed.

tasks.title: Gather Baseline System Information
tasks.objective: Collect comprehensive details about the host's operating system, installed packages, and network services to define the scope of the assessment.
tasks.rationale: Understanding the current state (OS version, kernel, installed software) is critical before running any vulnerability scanner to ensure accurate results and scope definition.
tasks.expected_output: A structured inventory report detailing OS version, kernel version, installed packages (with versions), and running services.
success_criteria: OS distribution and version are identified.
A list of all installed packages and their versions is generated.
All open network ports and associated services are documented.

tasks.title: Execute Vulnerability Scans
tasks.objective: Run multiple specialized scans (e.g., network, package, configuration) against the host using industry-standard tools.
tasks.rationale: A single scan is insufficient; multiple tools are needed to cover different attack vectors (network, application, configuration) and provide comprehensive coverage.
tasks.expected_output: Raw scan results files containing identified vulnerabilities, severity ratings, and affected assets.
success_criteria: At least three distinct types of scans (e.g., network, package, configuration) are executed.
All raw scan output files are successfully collected and stored.
The scan process completes without critical tool failures.

tasks.title: Aggregate and Triage Scan Results
tasks.objective: Consolidate all raw scan data, deduplicate findings, and categorize vulnerabilities by type and severity.
tasks.rationale: Raw scan data is often redundant and overwhelming; this task filters noise and creates a single, manageable list of unique vulnerabilities.
tasks.expected_output: A consolidated vulnerability matrix listing unique CVEs, their associated severity (CVSS score), and the affected component.
success_criteria: All raw scan results are successfully parsed and merged.
Duplicate findings are identified and merged into single entries.
The matrix includes a clear severity rating for every identified vulnerability.

tasks.title: Prioritize Risks and Develop Remediation Plan
tasks.objective: Analyze the consolidated vulnerability matrix to prioritize risks based on exploitability and business impact, and draft specific, actionable remediation steps.
tasks.rationale: A list of vulnerabilities is useless without a plan. This task translates technical findings into prioritized, step-by-step instructions for remediation.
tasks.expected_output: A prioritized remediation plan document detailing required patches, configuration changes, and mitigation strategies.
success_criteria: All critical and high-severity vulnerabilities are assigned a specific remediation action.
The plan distinguishes between immediate fixes and long-term architectural improvements.
The plan includes estimated effort/complexity for each remediation step.

tasks.title: Generate Final Assessment Report
tasks.objective: Compile all findings, the risk summary, and the remediation plan into a professional, executive-ready report.
tasks.rationale: The final deliverable must be easily understood by both technical teams (for execution) and management (for decision-making).
tasks.expected_output: A comprehensive final report containing an Executive Summary, Technical Findings, and the Actionable Remediation Plan.
success_criteria: The report includes a non-technical Executive Summary for leadership.
The report clearly links each vulnerability to a specific remediation step.
The final document is formatted and ready for presentation.
